title: The Golden Butterfly of the Enchanted Meadow
intro: A shimmering golden butterfly guides Lily to a secret field of musical wildflowers.
paragraphs: One warm afternoon, Lily was reading under an apple tree when a butterfly with shimmering metallic gold wings fluttered past her nose.
'Follow me!' the butterfly seemed to whisper with each flutter of its wings.
Lily followed the golden spark through a gap in the stone wall into an enchanted meadow. Soft, tinkling music echoed in the breeze.
The wildflowers were not ordinary flowers at all—they were musical bell flowers that chimed whenever the wind blew!
Lily sat gently in the fragrant grass and listened to the peaceful song of the meadow, smiling with pure wonder.

vocabulary.definition: Charming, magical, or filled with delightful wonder.
